argv:
set -euo pipefail
echo '@@ BOOT_START'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo '@@ TIME_START'
date -u +%s
cat /proc/uptime
echo '@@ KERNEL_RELEASE'
uname -r
echo '@@ SYSTEM_MODULE_HASH'
sha256sum /lib/modules/5.4.261/kernel/system_drv.ko
echo '@@ CMDLINE_BASE64'
head -c 8193 /proc/cmdline | base64
echo '@@ BOOT_END'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo '@@ TIME_END'
date -u +%s
cat /proc/uptime
